title: Shuffle 溢写与多路归并（外部排序范式）
expected_output:
spill #1: [('apple', 1), ('banana', 1), ('cherry', 1)]
spill #2: [('apple', 1), ('banana', 1), ('date', 1)]
spill #3: [('cherry', 1), ('fig', 1)]
merged all spills (sorted): [('apple', 1), ('apple', 1), ('banana', 1), ('banana', 1), ('cherry', 1), ('cherry', 1), ('date', 1), ('fig', 1)]
code:
import heapq
records = [("banana",1),("apple",1),("cherry",1),("apple",1),("date",1),("banana",1),("fig",1),("cherry",1)]
MEM = 3
spills = []
buf = []
for rec in records:
    buf.append(rec)
    if len(buf) >= MEM:
        buf.sort()
        spills.append(list(buf))
        print(f"spill #{len(spills)}: {buf}")
        buf = []
if buf:
    buf.sort()
    spills.append(list(buf))
    print(f"spill #{len(spills)}: {buf}")
merged = list(heapq.merge(*spills))
print("merged all spills (sorted):", merged)
